## Pancreas data

We fit rank-1 ICA to the top 25 and 30 whitened PCs of the same CEL-seq2 cells. We look at two ways to initialize the rank-1 fit:

- Random unit directions;
- Init from each row of the sample whitened data: $w_i^{(0)}=U_{i,1:k}/\|U_{i,1:k}\|_2$ for $i=1,\dots, n$.

```{r pancreas-data}
root <- if (file.exists("data/pancreas.RData")) "." else ".."
pancreas <- readRDS(file.path(root, "pancreas_CEL_seq2", "pancreas_CEL_seq2.rds"))
sample_info <- pancreas$metadata
library(Matrix)
raw <- new.env()
load(file.path(root, "data", "pancreas.RData"), envir = raw)
counts <- raw$counts[raw$sample_info$tech == "celseq2", , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(counts), sample_info$cell_id),
          identical(rownames(pancreas$pcs), sample_info$cell_id))
counts <- counts[, colSums(counts > 0) >= 10, drop = FALSE]
size <- rowSums(counts)
Y <- log1p(Diagonal(x = mean(size) / size) %*% counts)
set.seed(1)
sv <- irlba::irlba(Y, nv = 30, center = colMeans(Y), tol = 1e-9)
X <- sqrt(nrow(Y)) * sv$u
# Orient the first 25 PCs as in the saved analysis.
alignment <- diag(crossprod(pancreas$pcs, X[, 1:25])) / nrow(X)
stopifnot(all(abs(alignment) > 1 - 1e-8))
X[, 1:25] <- sweep(X[, 1:25], 2, sign(alignment), "*")
stopifnot(max(abs(colMeans(X))) < 1e-8,
          max(abs(crossprod(X) / nrow(X) - diag(30))) < 1e-8)
rm(raw, counts, Y, sv)
table(sample_info$celltype)
```

## Clustering and plotting functions


```{r plotting-functions}

source(file.path(root, "code", "ica_loading_plots.R"), local = TRUE)


prune_and_count_cluster <- function(L, tau = 0.9) {
  # Drop constant columns before computing correlation (zero variance -> NaN in cor())
  L <- L[, apply(L, 2, sd) > 1e-10, drop = FALSE]
  # 1. Convert correlation to distance (1 - absolute correlation)
  dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - abs(cor(L)))

  # 2. Hierarchical clustering
  # 'complete' linkage ensures no two rows in a cluster are further apart than the threshold
  hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "complete")

  # 3. Cut the dendrogram to form clusters (distance of 1 - tau corresponds to correlation of tau)
  clusters <- cutree(hc, h = 1 - tau)

  # 4. Select a representative from each cluster
  # match() quickly grabs the first index of each unique cluster ID
  kept_indices <- match(unique(clusters), clusters)

  # 5. Map the sizes to the exact order of kept_indices
  # Extract the cluster ID for each kept row, then use it to index the table
  cluster_sizes_table = table(clusters)
  kept_cluster_ids <- clusters[kept_indices]
  cluster_sizes <- as.integer(cluster_sizes_table[as.character(kept_cluster_ids)])

  list(
    pruned_matrix = L[,kept_indices , drop = FALSE],
    cluster_sizes = cluster_sizes,
    kept_indices = kept_indices,
    cluster_assignments = clusters
  )
}

celltype_palette <- c(
  "#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00",
  "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3",
  "#E7298A", "#66A61E", "#E6AB02", "#A6761D", "#666666"
)

obj_logcosh <- function(L) colMeans(log(cosh(L)))

lhat_ggplot <- function(Lhat.pc, idx, title, si = sample_info,
                         obj_fn = obj_logcosh, max_panels = 25,
                         color_by = c("celltype", "donor")) {
  if (sum(idx) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  color_by <- match.arg(color_by)
  palette <- if (color_by == "celltype") celltype_palette else
    c(D28 = "#0072B2", D29 = "#D55E00", D30 = "#009E73", D31 = "#CC79A7")
  legend_title <- if (color_by == "celltype") "Cell type" else "Donor"
  Lhat.prune <- Lhat.pc$pruned_matrix
  Lhat_sub   <- Lhat.prune[, idx, drop = FALSE]
  obj_sub    <- obj_fn(Lhat_sub)
  labels <- paste0("n:", Lhat.pc$cluster_sizes[idx], " obj:", round(obj_sub, 3))
  plots <- ica_loading_panels(Lhat_sub, labels, si[[color_by]], order(si$celltype),
    palette, legend_title, title, panel_order = order(obj_sub), max_panels = max_panels,
    point_size = 1, legend_point_size = 4.5)
  for (p in plots) print(p)
  invisible(plots)
}

plot_Lhat_maxima <- function(Lhat.pc, obj_threshold = 0.42, si = sample_info,
                              obj_fn = obj_logcosh, max_panels = 25, color_by = "celltype") {
  obj <- obj_fn(Lhat.pc$pruned_matrix)
  lhat_ggplot(Lhat.pc, obj > obj_threshold, paste0("Maxima (obj > ", obj_threshold, ")"), si, obj_fn, max_panels, color_by)
}

plot_Lhat_minima <- function(Lhat.pc, obj_threshold = 0.42, si = sample_info,
                              obj_fn = obj_logcosh, max_panels = 25, color_by = "celltype") {
  obj <- obj_fn(Lhat.pc$pruned_matrix)
  lhat_ggplot(Lhat.pc, obj <= obj_threshold, paste0("Minima (obj <= ", obj_threshold, ")"), si, obj_fn, max_panels, color_by)
}

# General version for unlabeled/unordered loading matrices
plot_loadings_matrix <- function(Lhat, label_prefix = "ct:", si = sample_info,
                                  obj_fn = obj_logcosh, max_panels = 25, labels = NULL) {
  obj <- obj_fn(Lhat)
  cell_order <- order(si$celltype)
  n_cells <- nrow(Lhat)
  n_comp <- ncol(Lhat)

  if (is.null(labels)) {
    o    <- order(obj)
    Lhat <- Lhat[, o, drop = FALSE]
    obj  <- obj[o]
    comp_labels <- make.unique(paste0(label_prefix, seq_len(n_comp), " obj:", round(obj, 3)))
  } else {
    comp_labels <- make.unique(paste0(labels, " obj:", round(obj, 3)))
  }
  df <- data.frame(
    rank      = rep(seq_len(n_cells), n_comp),
    celltype  = rep(si$celltype[cell_order], n_comp),
    loading   = as.vector(Lhat[cell_order, ]),
    component = factor(rep(comp_labels, each = n_cells), levels = comp_labels)
  )

  pages   <- split(comp_labels, ceiling(seq_along(comp_labels) / max_panels))
  n_pages <- length(pages)
  plots <- lapply(seq_along(pages), function(i) {
    pg_labels <- pages[[i]]
    df_pg <- df[df$component %in% pg_labels, ]
    df_pg$component <- factor(as.character(df_pg$component), levels = pg_labels)
    pg_title <- if (n_pages > 1) paste0(i, "/", n_pages) else NULL
    ggplot(df_pg, aes(x = rank, y = loading, color = celltype)) +
      geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
      facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_color_manual(values = celltype_palette) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Loading", color = "Cell type", title = pg_title) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            strip.text = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0)),
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
            legend.position = "bottom") +
      guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4.5, alpha = 1)))
  })
  for (p in plots) print(p)
  invisible(plots)
}
```

## FastICA


```{r fastica-fits}
pc_counts <- c(25L, 30L)
set.seed(1)
n_starts <- 1000L
draws <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(25L * n_starts), nrow = 25L),
               matrix(rnorm(5L * n_starts), nrow = 5L))
starts <- list()
run_labels <- character()
clusters <- list()
titles <- c(logcosh = "Log-cosh", cubic = "Cubic",
            signed_quadratic = "Signed quadratic", logphi = "Log-Phi (alpha = 1)",
            logphi3 = "Log-Phi (alpha = 3)")
objectives <- list(
  logcosh = obj_logcosh,
  cubic = function(L) colMeans(L^3),
  signed_quadratic = function(L) colMeans(L * abs(L) / 2),
  logphi = function(L) colMeans(pnorm(L, log.p = TRUE)),
  logphi3 = function(L) colMeans(pnorm(3 * L, log.p = TRUE))
)
solver_contrasts <- c(logcosh = "logcosh", cubic = "cubic",
                  signed_quadratic = "abs", logphi = "logphi", logphi3 = "logphi")
for (k in pc_counts) {
  key <- as.character(k)
  Z <- t(X[, seq_len(k)])
  W0 <- draws[seq_len(k), ]
  starts[[key]] <- sweep(W0, 2, sqrt(colSums(W0^2)), "/")
  run_labels[key] <- paste0(k, " PCs (random starts)")

  row_key <- paste0(k, "-rows")
  row_norms <- sqrt(colSums(Z^2))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(row_norms) & row_norms > 0))
  starts[[row_key]] <- sweep(Z, 2, row_norms, "/")
  colnames(starts[[row_key]]) <- sample_info$cell_id
  run_labels[row_key] <- paste0(k, " PCs (row starts)")
}
for (key in names(starts)) {
  Z <- t(X[, seq_len(nrow(starts[[key]]))])
  for (contrast in names(titles)) {
    W <- rank1_fastica_updates(Z, starts[[key]], solver_contrasts[[contrast]],
                              n_iter = 50L, alpha = if (contrast == "logphi3") 3 else 1)
    clusters[[key]][[contrast]] <- prune_and_count_cluster(crossprod(Z, W))
  }
}
```

```{r fastica-plots, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
plot_solver_clusters <- function(results, prefix, split_logcosh = FALSE) {
  views <- c(celltype = "Cell type", donor = "Donor")
  for (key in names(results)) {
    rank_id <- paste(prefix, key, sep = "-")
    cat("\n\n### ", run_labels[[key]], " {#", rank_id, " .tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    for (contrast in names(titles)) {
      id <- paste(rank_id, contrast, sep = "-")
      cat("\n\n#### ", titles[[contrast]], " {#", id, " .tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
      fit <- results[[key]][[contrast]]
      if (!ncol(fit$pruned_matrix)) {
        cat("No starts met the convergence criterion.\n\n")
        next
      }
      for (color_by in names(views)) {
        cat("\n\n##### ", views[[color_by]], " {#", id, "-", color_by, "}\n\n", sep = "")
        if (split_logcosh && contrast == "logcosh") {
          plot_Lhat_maxima(fit, color_by = color_by)
          plot_Lhat_minima(fit, color_by = color_by)
        } else {
          lhat_ggplot(fit, rep(TRUE, ncol(fit$pruned_matrix)), titles[[contrast]],
                      obj_fn = objectives[[contrast]], color_by = color_by)
        }
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
plot_solver_clusters(clusters, "fastica", split_logcosh = TRUE)
```

## Projected gradient ascent

Here we use the projected gradient ascent update:

$$
\boldsymbol{w}_{\mathrm{new}}
=
\frac{
\boldsymbol{w}+\eta(\boldsymbol{I}-\boldsymbol{ww}^\top)\nabla G(\boldsymbol{w})
}{
\|\boldsymbol{w}+\eta(\boldsymbol{I}-\boldsymbol{ww}^\top)\nabla G(w)\|_2
}.
$$


```{r projected-gradient}
fit_and_cluster <- function(solver) {
  fits <- clusters <- list()
  for (key in names(starts)) {
    Z <- t(X[, seq_len(nrow(starts[[key]]))])
    for (contrast in names(solver_contrasts)) {
      fit <- solver(Z, starts[[key]], solver_contrasts[[contrast]], tol = 1e-6,
                    alpha = if (contrast == "logphi3") 3 else 1)
      # Cell loadings can be recovered from Z and W for any start.
      fits[[key]][[contrast]] <- fit[c("W", "diagnostics", "trace")]
      converged <- fit$diagnostics$status == "converged"
      loadings <- crossprod(Z, fit$W[, converged, drop = FALSE])
      clusters[[key]][[contrast]] <- if (ncol(loadings) >= 2L) {
        prune_and_count_cluster(loadings)
      } else {
        list(pruned_matrix = loadings, cluster_sizes = rep(1L, ncol(loadings)))
      }
    }
  }
  list(fits = fits, clusters = clusters)
}
pg_results <- fit_and_cluster(fit_rank1_pg)
pg_fits <- pg_results$fits
pg_clusters <- pg_results$clusters
```


```{r projected-gradient-plots, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
plot_solver_clusters(pg_clusters, "pg")
```
